gold: Giant cell tumor of soft tissue (GCT-ST)

selector.rationale: Multinodular proliferation of osteoclast-like multinucleated giant cells and mononuclear cells with increased mitotic activity, positive for CD68 and negative for CD45, S100, desmin, and lysozyme, which are characteristic findings for Giant Cell Tumor

rejected.label: Hodgkin Lymphoma
rejected.why: Patient's history of Hodgkin lymphoma does not explain current presentation

rejected.label: Langerhans Cell Histiocytosis
rejected.why: Contradictory evidence, including negative S100 staining

rejected.label: PALB2-related tumor
rejected.why: Genetic finding of PALB2 splicing variant is noted but not specific to the tumor type
